args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Medications and first aid kit
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat and sunglasses
- Sleepwear

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- Backpack/daypack
- Trekking poles (optional)

SUN PROTECTION:
- High SPF sunscreen (reef-safe)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Lip balm with SPF
- Umbrella or portable shade

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Feminine hygiene products (if needed)

ELECTRONICS:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Power bank
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Waterproof speaker (optional)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow and eye mask
- Snacks for travel days
- Small backpack for day trips
- Laundry bag
- Ziplock bags for wet items
